notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
It is not your turn.
description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
Ghost Town enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo, creating a Rock equipment artifact token.
The Rock token enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Rock token and Battered Golem, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
